highlights: close proximity to the northumberland coastline
summary: A two bedroom apartment located within Ashington, in the heart of Northumberland, is a thriving and well-connected town that offers an excellent balance of convenience, community and coastal living.
description:
Known for its strong local identity and friendly atmosphere, Ashington provides a wide range of amenities including shops, supermarkets, leisure facilities, cafés and restaurants, along with well-regarded schools and healthcare services. The town benefits from excellent transport links, with easy access to the A189 and A19, making commuting to Newcastle, Morpeth and the wider North East straightforward. Ashington also enjoys close proximity to the stunning Northumberland coastline, with beautiful beaches, scenic coastal walks and countryside just a short drive away. With ongoing regeneration, improving infrastructure and a growing sense of investment, Ashington continues to be an increasingly popular choice for families, first-time buyers and investors alike, offering good value for money while retaining access to the natural beauty and heritage Northumberland is renowned for. The two-bedroom apartment offers well-planned and spacious accommodation, briefly comprising a welcoming entrance hall with a staircase rising to the first floor. The first-floor layout features a bright and open-plan lounge and kitchen area, creating a sociable and versatile living space ideal for modern living and entertaining. There are two well-proportioned bedrooms, each offering comfortable accommodation, along with a well-appointed family bathroom completing the internal layout. Externally there is a front garden space and allocated car parking to the rear. The apartment is currently tenanted and generating a rental income of £555 per calendar month, making it an attractive opportunity for investors seeking an immediate return.

ENTRANCE The apartment is accessed via a UPVC-framed double-glazed door, leading into a welcoming entrance hall. The hall provides stairs to the first floor, creating a practical and well-connected layout.

HALLWAY The hallway is both practical and inviting, featuring a built-in storage cupboard for added convenience, a radiator for warmth, and providing access to all rooms within the apartment, ensuring a well-connected and functional layout.

OPEN PLAN LOUNGE / DINING ROOM The apartment features a bright and spacious open-plan lounge and kitchen, ideal for modern living and entertaining. The lounge area is filled with natural light from a UPVC-framed double-glazed window and includes a radiator, creating a comfortable and welcoming living space. The kitchen is fitted with a contemporary range of base and wall units, complemented by laminate work surfaces with contrasting splashbacks. It features an inset sink with drainer and mixer tap, and a suite of integrated appliances including an oven, hob, washing machine, dishwasher and fridge freezer. A UPVC-framed double-glazed window ensures the kitchen is light and airy, completing this functional and stylish heart of the home.

BEDROM ONE Bedroom one is a well-proportioned double room, filled with natural light from a UPVC-framed double-glazed window. A radiator provides warmth, and the generous space allows for a variety of furniture arrangements, making it a comfortable and versatile bedroom.

BEDROOM TWO Bedroom two is a bright and airy room, featuring two UPVC-framed double-glazed windows that allow natural light to flood the space. A radiator provides warmth, and the room offers ample space for bedroom furniture, making it both practical and inviting.

FAMILY BATHROOM The family bathroom is fitted with a modern white suite comprising a panelled bath with an inset mains shower over, a wash hand basin, and a WC. The walls are partially tiled, complemented by a laminate floor for a clean, practical finish. A radiator provides warmth, creating a bright, functional, and well-appointed bathroom.

EXTERNALLY Externally, the apartment benefits from a communal garden at the front, thoughtfully landscaped with trees and shrubbery to provide both greenery and a sense of privacy. This shared outdoor space offers a pleasant environment for relaxation and adds to the overall appeal of the property.
